subject: Appointment
detail: Ashiana Housing Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr. Harvinder Singh Khatri as Vice President - Corporate HR of the company w.e.f. November 17, 2026.

subject: General Updates
detail: Ashiana Housing Limited has informed the Exchange about submission of intimation under Regulation 7(2) of the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 pertaining to purchase of shares received from Mr. Tushar Padalkar, one of the Designated Persons of the company
